strategy.thesis: Integrated family office of Eric and Wendy Schmidt managing the family's capital, investments and philanthropy. One of the most active family offices in frontier technology, with a heavy concentration in artificial intelligence since 2019.

summary.en: Hillspire is the Menlo Park-based integrated family office of former Google CEO Eric Schmidt and Wendy Schmidt, founded in 2006. It is one of the most venture-active US family offices: per Fintrx data it made 15 investments in 2025 (mostly AI), topping CNBC's inaugural Family Office 15 ranking, and has backed 22+ private AI companies since 2019 including Anthropic, SandboxAQ and Reflection AI.

strategy.thesis: Family office and personal investment vehicle of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. Invests across early and late stage in a wide range of sectors, with a recent concentration in AI and robotics.

summary.en: Bezos Expeditions is the Mercer Island, Washington family office and personal venture-investment vehicle of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, established as an LLC in 2005. It has backed 120+ companies across both early and late stage, including Airbnb, Uber, Twitter and a recent wave of AI/robotics bets (Perplexity, Figure, Physical Intelligence). It ranked second on CNBC's 2025 Family Office 15.

strategy.thesis: Hybrid multi-family office for ultra-high-net-worth tech and entertainment figures (clients reportedly include Mark Zuckerberg, Sheryl Sandberg, Jack Dorsey). Its ICONIQ Growth arm is one of Silicon Valley's most active later-stage software/growth venture investors.

summary.en: Iconiq Capital is a San Francisco hybrid multi-family office founded in December 2011 by ex-Goldman/Morgan Stanley advisors Divesh Makan, Michael Anders and Chad Boeding, managing roughly $80B for ultra-wealthy tech and entertainment clients. Its venture/growth arm ICONIQ Growth closed a $5.75B seventh flagship fund in 2024 and has backed Snowflake, Datadog, Zoom, CrowdStrike and GitLab.

strategy.thesis: Family office / investment vehicle of PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel, providing strategic and operational support for his ventures. Incubated Founders Fund, Mithril Capital and Valar Ventures, and makes direct long-duration bets across technology, healthcare, defense and aerospace.

summary.en: Thiel Capital is the Los Angeles family office / investment firm of PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel, formed in 2011. It provides strategic and operational support for Thiel's ventures, incubated Founders Fund, Mithril and Valar Ventures, and makes direct investments across deeptech, fintech, biotech, defense and aerospace. CNBC ranked it among the most active family offices, tied sixth with 14 investments in 2024.

summary.en: Emerson Collective is the Palo Alto LLC founded in 2004 by Laurene Powell Jobs that blends philanthropy, impact investing and venture capital across education, immigration, climate, health and media. It has backed Commonwealth Fusion Systems, Boom Supersonic and Chai Discovery, owns a majority stake in The Atlantic, and tied for third on CNBC's 2025 Family Office 15 with a focus on human-centric AI and women's health.

strategy.thesis: Hybrid philanthropic investment firm (501(c)(3) + LLC) founded by eBay founder Pierre Omidyar and wife Pam. Combines strategic grant-making with for-profit impact investing across financial inclusion, governance/democracy, technology and society, education and property rights.

summary.en: Omidyar Network is the Redwood City hybrid philanthropy-and-impact-investing firm founded in 2004 by eBay founder Pierre Omidyar and his wife Pam, structured as a 501(c)(3) plus an LLC. By 2025 it had committed almost $2 billion to 700+ nonprofit and for-profit organizations across financial inclusion, governance, technology-and-society and education, and spun off Spero Ventures, Luminate, Flourish and Imaginable Futures. It is cited as among the most active family offices making direct startup investments.

summary.en: Winklevoss Capital is the New York family office founded in 2012 by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, investing seed/early-stage capital across four 'frontiers' — Crypto, Space, Energy and Bio. An early Bitcoin and crypto-infrastructure backer (Protocol Labs, Filecoin) and founder of the Gemini exchange, with other bets including Flexport, Kindbody and The Sandbox.

strategy.thesis: Impact-focused vehicle of Mitch Kapor (Lotus Software founder) and Freada Kapor Klein. Pioneered 'gap-closing investing' — backing seed-stage startups that close opportunity gaps for low-income communities and communities of color while delivering venture returns.

summary.en: Kapor Capital is the Oakland-based impact-investing vehicle of Lotus Software founder Mitch Kapor and Freada Kapor Klein, investing exclusively in seed-stage 'gap-closing' startups since 2011. It has invested $106M+ across 170+ companies (62% women-led or underrepresented founders) at an IRR of about 30%, ranking it in the top quartile of US VC funds; portfolio includes Twilio.

summary.en: Webb Investment Network (WIN) is the seed-stage investment vehicle founded in 2010 by former eBay COO Maynard Webb, who is its sole LP. It writes $500K–$750K checks and surrounds portfolio companies with an Affiliate Network of 70+ tech operators. WIN has backed 140+ companies, with exits/IPOs including Okta, PagerDuty and AppLovin.

summary.en: Raptor Group is the Boston single-family office founded in 2009 by hedge-fund veteran Jim Pallotta (former Tudor Investment Vice Chairman). It deploys permanent capital across venture, growth and public strategies in technology, fintech, sports, consumer, media and healthcare; early private bets include Snapchat, Spotify, Uber, Reddit and Paxos. It tied for third on CNBC's 2025 Family Office 15.

summary.en: Builders Vision is the Chicago-based investing-and-philanthropy platform of Walmart heir Lukas Walton, which shifted its ~$1B endowment into impact investments. Its venture/growth arm S2G Investments (founded 2014 as S2G Ventures with a $100M food/ag fund) grew to ~$2.5B managed across 100+ portfolio companies and spun out as an independent RIA in 2024; portfolio includes Beyond Meat, Sweetgreen and Apeel.

summary.en: The Pritzker Organization (TPO) is the Chicago single-family office of Hyatt executive chairman Tom Pritzker, founded in 1990. In 2022 it launched 53 Stations, a $190M venture fund led by Jason Pritzker and ex-General Catalyst partner Kevin King, writing $1M–$10M checks from seed to Series B (property-tech/construction-tech focus); early bets include Altana and Whisper Aero.

strategy.thesis: Family office managing the capital of Michael Dell and family. Multi-disciplinary strategy across credit, private equity, real estate and growth equity, focused on long-term capital appreciation; growth-equity arm makes later-stage private investments.

summary.en: DFO Management (formerly MSD Capital) is the New York family office managing Michael Dell's capital, formed in 1998 and restructured as DFO at the end of 2022. It runs a multi-disciplinary strategy across credit, private equity, real estate and growth equity; venture-relevant activity is later-stage/growth — e.g. a $130M 2025 investment in primary-care group Harbor Health.
